name: Motley Lots
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 20-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round per level
Saving Throw: Will negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the targets to become disoriented.

Affected creatures take a -2 penalty on attack rolls.
